tasks.title: Define Encryption Logic
tasks.description: Research and select a simple encryption algorithm suitable for a beginner-level Python module (e.g., Caesar Cipher or XOR encryption). Define the requirements for the encryption and decryption functions.

tasks.title: Implement Python Encryption Module
tasks.description: Develop a Python script named 'encryptor.py' that includes functions for encrypting and decrypting text based on the logic defined in Task 1. Include a main block for demonstration.

tasks.title: Validate and Review Module
tasks.description: Review the Python code for PEP 8 compliance, test it with various string inputs including special characters and numbers, and ensure that decrypted text matches the original input exactly.
